title: Find female patients aged 60 or older who have had at least two laboratory
question: Find female patients aged 60 or older who have had at least two laboratory tests with abnormal hematocrit levels and a normal prothrombin time. Return their ID, age, admission status, and whether they have severe thrombosis (Thrombosis = 1 or 2).

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    STRFTIME('%Y', DATE('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS age,
    P."XCL_062" AS admission_status,
    CASE WHEN E."XCL_013" IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS severe_thrombosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', DATE('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") >= 60
  AND P."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT L."XCL_014"
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE (L."XCL_033" >= 52 OR L."XCL_033" <= 29)
      AND L."XCL_021" BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5
    GROUP BY L."XCL_014"
    HAVING COUNT(L."XCL_014") >= 2
  )
ORDER BY P."XCL_058"

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT P."XCL_058",
       STRFTIME('%Y', DATE('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS age,
       P."XCL_061" AS admission_status,
       CASE WHEN E."XCL_003" IN (1,2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS severe_thrombosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
JOIN Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', DATE('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") >= 60
  AND NOT (L."XCL_021" >= 3.5 AND L."XCL_021" <= 5.5)
  AND L."XCL_022" >= 3.5 AND L."XCL_022" <= 5.5
GROUP BY P."XCL_058", P."XCL_060", P."XCL_061", E."XCL_003"
HAVING COUNT(L."XCL_014") >= 2
ORDER BY P."XCL_058"
